Messages.Body:
tremere gets blocked, slave uses ability to get into combat.

thanks,
leviathan

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>tremere gets blocked, slave uses ability to get into combat.
>can kiss of ra be played?

No. You use the Slave ability when the action is already blocked and combat is
about to be entered, but by that time it's too late to play the Kiss of Ra. If
Kiss of Ra is played however, it ends the action and there's no chance to use
the Slave ability.

>can slave untap after combat with freak drive?

No. The slave is not the acting minion and thus cannot play action modifiers.

Halcyan 2
